meta.name: bookmark-research
meta.description: Read the complete frozen bookmark inventory in groups, independently verify evidence, close coverage gaps, and save a cited report.

research_id.description: Existing research session with a frozen source inventory

run_key.description: Unique local invocation key; keep it unchanged when the host resumes this run

group_size.description: Sources per reading group, from 1 to 50

max_gap_rounds.description: Additional reading and verification rounds, from 0 to 4

method.description: Research method: comparison, fact checking, or benchmark analysis

output_language.description: Output language name or code, such as en or zh. Auto follows the brief/questions, with English as the fallback. Original quotations and identifiers are preserved.

bridge_path.description: Optional absolute path to hosts/shared/research-call.py when native MCP tools are unavailable
